cell_type_or_model: CD36 fusion proteins, macrophages and corneal-pocket model
assay_or_perturbation: TSP2/CD36 domain binding and CD36-dependent antiangiogenic assays
evidence_summary: TSP2 interaction with CD36 and CD36-dependent antiangiogenic output are supported.
limitations: Non-SCI comparator; no terminal TF or universal receptor relay was measured.

assay_or_perturbation: αVβ3 blockade/knockdown; RGDS sensitivity; NF-κB/MMP9, adhesion and migration assays
evidence_summary: THBS2-associated αVβ3 signaling modulates vascular and migration outputs.
limitations: Complex stoichiometry and direct binding remain unresolved in the cited pathway studies.

assay_or_perturbation: THBS2/SDC4 perturbation; EMT and matrix-remodeling assays
evidence_summary: THBS2–SDC4-associated matrix and EMT output is supported in disease-context models.
limitations: No SCI receiver model, receptor-proximal kinase chain or terminal TF was established.
